biggest_catch: Geography and tenure filters: membership requires Pacific Northwest residence (Horizon verifies residence at application; field covers Washington and select Oregon, Idaho, Montana counties), and you cannot hold or have held a Horizon checking account within the last five years. Youth and Business accounts are excluded.
catches: Open a new Horizon Credit Union personal checking account (any account qualifies) and use promo code get200 at opening; The Tether Savings Bundle also qualifies.
Fund the account with at least $250 within 5 business days of account opening.
Complete at least 15 debit card transactions within 60 days of the account open date.
Accept electronic statement delivery in Horizon online banking within 60 days.
Keep the checking account open and in good standing for 60 days; the $200 is deposited within 60 days of all qualifications being met.
Members must be 18 or older; membership fee may apply; one offer per household; offer may be modified or canceled at any time.
Bonus is taxable income; taxes are the member's responsibility.
